title: Week 3 of building an open world for an Elder Scrolls Black Marsh spin-off with Fable
author: Potential_Ad_7544
selftext:
Given some of the things people have been putting out here in the last few days with Astra, it now feels like I'm going kinda slowly with this. I wanted to take some time and go through it layer by layer to steer for taste rather than aim for something more on the one-shotting end of the spectrum so we are where we are.

  
Goal here is less like building a new game, and more like creating a standalone/overhaul Skyrim mod with a brand new open world, new engine and mechanics. The aim is a spinoff game that has:

* The soul of TES3 Morrowind - I never felt any of the later titles really scratched the same itch that that game did
* The combat of dark souls, with a custom combat engine (properly tuned and tested so it's not just like skyrim with rolling)
* Set in Argonia/Black Marsh, in 4E 201, with a whole new main quest, set of factions, minor quests, NPCs etc to the same density level and with the same variety as Morrowind - all grounded in/extrapolated from real lore and canon in logical ways. And that is properly fun and doesn't just read like AI crap
* Claude doing all the coding (mostly Fable, + some tightly-scoped and directed Opus subagents with Fable doing the planning).

Secondary goal is to open source the repo so other people can nab stuff from it and shortcut some of the things that can make this process a faff.

I'm going through this system by system roughly in order of 'risk', like 'if we can't get this to feel good enough then there's no point trying anything else'. First two things are (1) a combat sandbox, which [you can play here](https://jtattersall09403.github.io/elder-souls-argonia/) if you are interested - lots of issues with it so it's just a work in progress; and (2) the world build. Have been working on developing systems for procedurally placing vegetation the last couple of days - trees, grass, bushes etc, with sufficient variation and cohesion at the micro and macro level.

As an aside I have today tried getting Astra to fix a bunch of stuff with the water and I have not had the success with it others have so far. It burned through 3 resets on a $100 pro plan, fixed some things and completely messed up a bunch of others. Just to share my experience.

Any advice much appreciated
